segments.headline: Sensex sheds nearly 1,000 · SEBI eyes Tata-APL deal
segments.cap: The Sensex fell nearly 1,000 points today. And SEBI is now looking at a big Tata Steel takeover deal.

segments.headline: Sensex sheds nearly 1,000
segments.cap: The Sensex fell nearly 1,000 points on Friday. The Nifty lost 277 points. Brent crude rose above $96 a barrel, which brings back worry about India's import bill.
segments.tts: [excited] The Sensex fell nearly one thousand points on Friday. The Nifty lost two hundred seventy-seven points. Brent crude rose above ninety-six dollars a barrel, which brings back worry about India's import bill.

head: SENSEX DOWN
NEARLY 1,000
beats.note: Indian shares ended *the day lower*, and the Nifty gave up *277 points.*

head: OIL ABOVE
beats.note: Costlier oil can raise *India's import bill*, so investors turned *more careful.*

segments.headline: SEBI eyes Tata-APL deal
segments.cap: SEBI says it is looking at the Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. Tata Steel will buy the promoters' stake for ₹15,510 crore. It will also make an open offer for up to 26% more. Proxy advisory firms worry that small shareholders may lose out.
segments.tts: [excited] SEBI says it is looking at the Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. Tata Steel will buy the promoters' stake for fifteen thousand five hundred ten crore rupees. It will also make an open offer for up to twenty-six percent more. Proxy advisory firms worry that small shareholders may lose out.

head: IS SEBI
WATCHING?
beats.note: The regulator says *minority shareholders* matter, and it is *looking at the deal.*

head: TATA BUYS
THE PROMOTERS
beats.note: Tata Steel is taking *control* of the tube maker by *buying the promoters' stake.*

head: THEN AN
OPEN OFFER
beats.note: Public shareholders can also *sell their shares* in an offer for up to *26% more.*

head: SMALL HOLDERS
AT RISK?
beats.note: Advisers say the *structure* of the deal may not be *fair to minority shareholders.*

segments.headline: RBI eases daily CRR rule
segments.cap: The RBI has cut the daily cash reserve rule for banks to 90% from 99%. It starts on 1 December. Banking liquidity has slipped into deficit. The next RBI policy review is coming, and a 25 basis point rate hike is widely expected.
segments.tts: [excited] The RBI has cut the daily cash reserve rule for banks to ninety percent from ninety-nine percent. It starts on the first of December. Banking liquidity has slipped into deficit. The next RBI policy review is coming, and a twenty-five basis point rate hike is widely expected.

head: RBI EASES
THE CRR RULE
beats.note: Banks must keep *less cash idle* with the RBI each day, from *99% down to 90%.*

head: WHY NOW?
CASH IS TIGHT
beats.note: System liquidity *slipped into deficit*, and that has pushed *short-term rates higher.*

head: POLICY
REVIEW NEXT
beats.note: Most experts expect a *25 basis point* rate hike at the *policy review.*

segments.headline: 1 million AI satellites OK'd
segments.cap: In the US, the FCC has approved up to 1 million SpaceX satellites. They are meant to work as data centres in space, powered by sunlight. Amazon called it a lofty ambition, not a real plan. The approval has conditions, and the full network has until 2040.
segments.tts: [excited] In the US, the FCC has approved up to one million SpaceX satellites. They are meant to work as data centres in space, powered by sunlight. Amazon called it a lofty ambition, not a real plan. The approval has conditions, and the full network has until twenty forty.

head: 1 MILLION
SATELLITES?
beats.note: The US regulator approved *SpaceX's plan* for AI computing *powered by sunlight.*

head: REAL PLAN
OR DREAM?
beats.note: Amazon and others *objected*, and the approval is *conditional*, with a *2040 deadline.*
